stories.headline: Apple Pay Launches In India, Partners With Axis Bank
stories.summary: Apple has launched its mobile payment service, Apple Pay, in India, partnering with Axis Bank as its first local banking partner. This rollout enables Apple users in the country to register their cards and make contactless payments using their devices.

stories.headline: 👨🏿‍🚀TechCabal Daily – Keeping it micro
stories.summary: This digest highlights Kenyan mobility startup BuuPass, detailing its early days testing a matatu-booking service in Ongata Rongai. The newsletter also covers other regional tech developments, including retail-tech platform Copia's assets falling short of its debts, MTN's entry into the micro-drama market, and Vodacom's network capacity expansion.

stories.headline: MoneyHero shareholder urges board to explore sale after stock slump
stories.summary: MoneyHero's largest unaffiliated shareholder, Jonathan Honig, is publicly urging the board to explore a sale of the company. The Singapore-based personal finance platform, which is listed on Nasdaq, is currently facing leadership uncertainty, stalled revenue growth, and a sharp decline in its stock price.
